description: This file defines the 'ViewModifySearch' class for the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM module, responsible for handling the modification of search settings within the Connector administration interface. It includes methods to generate page titles, determine the module tab, and render the interface with connectors that are enabled in both admin search and wizard contexts.

classes.name: ViewModifySearch
classes.description: A class extending SugarView that provides functionality for modifying connector search settings within the administration module. It includes methods for generating module titles, determining module tab, and rendering the modification interface with active connectors.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the breadcrumb links for the module page, including links to Administration, Connectors, and the current 'Modify Search' title.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the string 'Administration' indicating the current module tab.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Loads connector data, filters for enabled connectors in admin search and wizard, and renders the modify search template.
